title: Beware of becoming the monster
idea: He who fights monsters should be careful not to become one. Fighting something long enough can change you into it.
apply: After a conflict, check whether you used the same tactics you condemned. If so, step back.
remind: Do not become what you fight.
who: Kofi, a forum moderator worn down by trolls.

scenes.nar: Kofi moderates a community forum. After months of trolls, he starts firing back with sarcasm of his own.
Six months in, he snaps at ordinary members, hunts for fights, and feels bitter all day. The fight has changed him.

items: Am I becoming what I fight?
Reply with the written rules, not rage

scenes.nar: Nietzsche warned that fighting monsters can turn you into one. Kofi sets a rule: reply only with the written policy, never with his temper.
His replies become calm and short. The trolls lose interest, and Kofi enjoys the work again.
